name: Zephyr Brisas BML 30" Stainless Steel Island Range Hood
shortDescription: Brisas BML can be installed in as little as 20 minutes. Designed with a unique 3-step installation system, Brisas BML breaks the arduous task of installing the entire range hood into a few easy steps. There's even an installation template to help you align your ceiling marks without the guesswork. The unit is also upgraded with LumiLight LED lighting and electronic touch controls. One look at the classic European design and gentle clear-glass curved canopy will have you sold. Love at first site? Yes. It’s possible.

features.text: Electronic touch controls adjust the range hood blower and LED light levels, and enable the auto delay-off function.
Airflow Control Technology or ACT is an exclusive technology that gives installers the ability to set the maximum CFM levels to meet local code requirements.
LumiLight LED lights are eco-friendly and built to last with a lifetime of more than 25,000 hours.
High-quality, dishwasher-safe aluminum mesh filters for improved capture and performance.

Zephyrs Quick-Lock Installation System is an innovative, hassle-free method for installing island range hoods. A quick-lock motion lets the user assemble the frame, lift the hood and lock it into place on the frame and then assemble the 4-piece duct covers. This easy three-step process ensures the island hood is securely installed without additional build-out required. While most island range hood installations require at least three people, Zephyrs Quick-Lock Installation can be completed by one or two people.
Ductless recirculating kit used when venting air outside your home is not possible. Smoke and odors pass through charcoal filters allowing purified air to be reintroduced into the kitchen.
Extension duct cover kit to accommodate ceiling heights up to 12 ft see spec sheets for more details.
